source.prompt: Create one internally consistent 5-column by 2-row sprite atlas for ten tiny collectible game icons. Columns: pink cherry blossom, white daisy with yellow centre, red-pink tulip, coral-red hibiscus, and a small mixed bouquet. Top row: the same flower closed or just opening. Bottom row: fully open. Each bud must unmistakably match the bloom below it in colour family and identity; the bouquet bud is a compact tied cluster of closed buds and its bloom is the matching tied bouquet. Use original glossy, bright, saturated emoji-like 3D rendering suitable beside modern iPad flower emoji, with soft dimensional shading, crisp highlights, clean simple silhouettes, and no vendor-art copying. Centre each isolated subject in an equal square cell with identical margin and perceived scale. Use a flat #ff00ff removable background, no background shadow, grid, text, watermark, border or outline strokes. Keep every subject legible at 20-24 px. Avoid thin line art, flat painted pastel style, green sprout-only icons, excess foliage, tiny detail, realism, glow, halo and fuzzy edges.
source.notes: The built-in generator returned native RGBA rather than the requested key colour. The ten cells were cut, disconnected alpha dust was removed, the main component was fitted within an 82px box on a 96px transparent canvas, and each runtime file was encoded as lossless WebP. No second or third generation attempt was needed.

qa.note: QA WebPs are intentionally git-ignored under repository size policy and must be filed in the sidecar at the same repo-relative paths.
